from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import time
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable, Generator, Iterable, Sequence
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal, overload

from tqdm.auto import tqdm
from vllm.logger import init_logger
from vllm.sampling_params import RequestOutputKind

from vllm_omni.engine.messages import OutputMessage
from vllm_omni.entrypoints.client_request_state import ClientRequestState
from vllm_omni.entrypoints.omni_base import OmniBase
from vllm_omni.metrics.stats import OrchestratorAggregator as OrchestratorMetrics
from vllm_omni.outputs import OmniRequestOutput

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from vllm_omni.inputs.data import OmniPromptType, OmniSamplingParams

logger = init_logger(__name__)


class Omni(OmniBase):
    """Synchronous entrypoint for offline generation."""

    def _maybe_force_final_only_for_llm_stages(
        self,
        sampling_params_list: Sequence[OmniSamplingParams],
    ) -> list[OmniSamplingParams]:
        """Return per-stage params with LLM stages forced to FINAL_ONLY.

        The caller may explicitly request ``output_kind = DELTA`` on a stage to
        opt into streaming; such stages are left alone.  All other LLM stages
        are forced to FINAL_ONLY.
        """
        effective_params: list[OmniSamplingParams] = []
        for stage_id, params in enumerate(sampling_params_list):
            sp = copy.deepcopy(params)
            stage_meta = self.engine.get_stage_metadata(stage_id)
            if (
                stage_meta.stage_type != "diffusion"
                and hasattr(sp, "output_kind")
                and sp.output_kind != RequestOutputKind.DELTA
            ):
                sp.output_kind = RequestOutputKind.FINAL_ONLY
            effective_params.append(sp)
        return effective_params

    @overload
    def generate(
        self,
        prompts: OmniPromptType | Sequence[OmniPromptType],
        sampling_params_list: OmniSamplingParams | Sequence[OmniSamplingParams] | None = None,
        *,
        py_generator: Literal[True],
        use_tqdm: bool | Callable[..., tqdm] = True,
    ) -> Generator[OmniRequestOutput, None, None]: ...

    @overload
    def generate(
        self,
        prompts: OmniPromptType | Sequence[OmniPromptType],
        sampling_params_list: OmniSamplingParams | Sequence[OmniSamplingParams] | None = None,
        *,
        py_generator: Literal[False] = False,
        use_tqdm: bool | Callable[..., tqdm] = True,
    ) -> list[OmniRequestOutput]: ...

    def generate(
        self,
        prompts: OmniPromptType | Sequence[OmniPromptType],
        sampling_params_list: OmniSamplingParams | Sequence[OmniSamplingParams] | None = None,
        *,
        py_generator: bool = False,
        use_tqdm: bool | Callable[..., tqdm] = True,
    ) -> Generator[OmniRequestOutput, None, None] | list[OmniRequestOutput]:
        # Expand sampling params for PD disaggregation (user may provide N-1 params)
        if (
            sampling_params_list is not None
            and isinstance(sampling_params_list, Sequence)
            and not isinstance(sampling_params_list, (str, bytes))
        ):
            sampling_params_list = self._maybe_expand_sampling_params(list(sampling_params_list))
        sampling_params_list = self.resolve_sampling_params_list(sampling_params_list)
        try:
            if py_generator:
                return self._run_generation_with_generator(prompts, sampling_params_list, use_tqdm)
            return list(self._run_generation(prompts, sampling_params_list, use_tqdm))
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("[Omni] Failed to run generation: %s", e)
            self.close()
            raise

    def _run_generation_with_generator(
        self,
        prompts: OmniPromptType | Sequence[OmniPromptType],
        sampling_params_list: Sequence[OmniSamplingParams],
        use_tqdm: bool | Callable[..., tqdm] = True,
    ) -> Generator[OmniRequestOutput, None, None]:
        gen = self._run_generation(prompts, sampling_params_list, use_tqdm)
        try:
            yield from gen
        finally:
            self.close()

    def _run_generation(
        self,
        prompts: OmniPromptType | Sequence[OmniPromptType],
        sampling_params_list: Sequence[OmniSamplingParams],
        use_tqdm: bool | Callable[..., tqdm] = True,
    ) -> Generator[OmniRequestOutput, None, None]:
        try:
            sampling_params_list = self._maybe_force_final_only_for_llm_stages(sampling_params_list)

            if isinstance(prompts, str) or not isinstance(prompts, Sequence):
                request_prompts: list[OmniPromptType] = [prompts]
            else:
                request_prompts = list(prompts)

            if not request_prompts:
                return

            request_ids = [f"{i}_{uuid.uuid4()}" for i in range(len(request_prompts))]
            req_start_ts: dict[str, float] = {}
            wall_start_ts = time.time()
            req_final_stage_ids: dict[str, int] = {}

            for req_id, prompt in zip(request_ids, request_prompts):
                prompt_modalities = prompt.get("modalities", None) if isinstance(prompt, dict) else None
                final_stage_id = self._compute_final_stage_id(prompt_modalities)
                final_output_stage_ids = self._compute_final_output_stage_ids(prompt_modalities) or [final_stage_id]
                req_final_stage_ids[req_id] = final_stage_id

                metrics = OrchestratorMetrics(
                    self.num_stages,
                    self.log_stats,
                    wall_start_ts,
                    final_stage_id,
                )
                req_state = ClientRequestState(req_id)
                req_state.metrics = metrics
                self.request_states[req_id] = req_state

                # PD disaggregation: modify stage-0 (prefill) sampling params per request
                req_sp_list = list(sampling_params_list)
                pd_pair = self._get_pd_separation_pair()
                if pd_pair is not None:
                    p_id = pd_pair[0]
                    req_sp_list[p_id] = self._prepare_prefill_sampling_params(req_id, req_sp_list[p_id])

                self.engine.add_request(
                    request_id=req_id,
                    prompt=prompt,
                    sampling_params_list=req_sp_list,
                    final_stage_id=final_stage_id,
                    final_output_stage_ids=final_output_stage_ids,
                )
                submit_ts = time.time()
                req_state.metrics.stage_first_ts[0] = submit_ts
                req_start_ts[req_id] = submit_ts

            active_reqs = set(request_ids)
            pbar = None
            if use_tqdm:
                tqdm_func = use_tqdm if callable(use_tqdm) else tqdm
                pbar = tqdm_func(total=len(request_ids), desc="Processed prompts", dynamic_ncols=True)

            while active_reqs:
                msg = self.engine.try_get_output()

                should_continue, req_id, stage_id, req_state = self._handle_output_message(msg)
                if should_continue:
                    continue

                if req_id not in active_reqs:
                    logger.warning("[Omni] Received output for unknown/finished request_id=%s", req_id)
                    continue

                self._check_engine_output_error(msg, req_id, stage_id)

                if req_state.metrics is None:
                    continue
                output_to_yield = self._process_single_result(
                    result=msg,
                    stage_id=stage_id,
                    metrics=req_state.metrics,
                    req_start_ts=req_start_ts,
                    wall_start_ts=wall_start_ts,
                    final_stage_id_for_e2e=req_final_stage_ids[req_id],
                )
                if output_to_yield is not None:
                    yield output_to_yield

                if isinstance(msg, OutputMessage) and msg.finished:
                    active_reqs.discard(req_id)
                    if pbar is not None:
                        pbar.update(1)
                    self._log_summary_and_cleanup(req_id)
        except Exception:
            if "active_reqs" in locals() and active_reqs:
                self.abort(list(active_reqs))
            raise
        finally:
            if "pbar" in locals() and pbar is not None:
                pbar.close()

    def abort(self, request_id: str | Iterable[str]) -> None:
        request_ids = [request_id] if isinstance(request_id, str) else list(request_id)
        self.engine.abort(request_ids)
        for req_id in request_ids:
            self.request_states.pop(req_id, None)
        if self.log_stats:
            logger.info("[Omni] Aborted request(s) %s", ",".join(request_ids))

# Disaggregated Inference for Omni-Modality Models

This guide explains how to configure and use distributed connectors
(`vllm_omni/distributed/omni_connectors`) in vllm-omni for multi-stage pipelines.

Backend-specific setup lives in separate docs:

- [SharedMemoryConnector](omni_connectors/shared_memory_connector.md)
- [MooncakeStoreConnector](omni_connectors/mooncake_store_connector.md)
- [MooncakeTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/mooncake_transfer_engine_connector.md)
- [MoriTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/mori_transfer_engine_connector.md)
- [YuanrongConnector](omni_connectors/yuanrong_connector.md)
- [YuanrongTransferEngineConnector](omni_connectors/yuanrong_transfer_engine_connector.md)

## Overview

Connectors enable data transfer between pipeline stages (e.g., Thinker -> Talker).
Current connectors operate in D2H2D (device to host to device) mode.

## Connector Choices

| Use Case | Recommended Connector | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Single node | SharedMemoryConnector | Auto-configured if no connector is specified. |
| Multi node (Mooncake Store) | MooncakeStoreConnector | TCP-based, requires Mooncake Master + metadata server. |
| Multi node (Mooncake RDMA) | MooncakeTransferEngineConnector | RDMA/TCP direct transfer with managed memory pool. Fastest. |
| Multi node (Mori RDMA) | MoriTransferEngineConnector | RDMA direct transfer via Mori IOEngine. |
| Multi node (Yuanrong) | YuanrongConnector | Requires Yuanrong Datasystem + etcd. |
| Ascend NPU P2P (Yuanrong TE) | YuanrongTransferEngineConnector | Uses Yuanrong TransferEngine directly. Configure NPU device IPv4 and `memory_pool_device: "npu"`. |

## Core API

The connector system is built around `OmniConnectorBase`.

```python
class OmniConnectorBase(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def put(self, from_stage: str, to_stage: str, put_key: str, data: Any) -> tuple[bool, int, Optional[dict]]:
        """
        Store data.
        Returns: (success, serialized_size, metadata)
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def get(self, from_stage: str, to_stage: str, get_key: str, metadata: Optional[dict] = None) -> Optional[tuple[Any, int]]:
        """
        Retrieve data.
        Args: metadata - transport-specific handles returned by put() (e.g., SHM name).
        Returns: (object, serialized_size)
        """
        pass
```

### Metadata Passing

Some connectors (e.g., SharedMemoryConnector) generate transient resources during `put()`.
This `metadata` must be passed through the control plane so `get()` can locate the data.

## Configuration Model

Define connectors in runtime:

```yaml
runtime:
  connectors:
    connector_of_shared_memory:
      name: SharedMemoryConnector
```

Wire stages to connectors:

```yaml
stage_args:
  - stage_id: 0
    output_connectors:
      to_stage_1: connector_of_shared_memory

  - stage_id: 1
    input_connectors:
      from_stage_0: connector_of_shared_memory
```

If a pipeline edge has no explicit connector, the system auto-creates a
SharedMemoryConnector for that edge.

## Relationship with vLLM

vLLM provides specialized distributed mechanisms for specific artifacts:

- KV Transfer (`vllm.distributed.kv_transfer`): optimized for KV caches.
- EC Transfer (`vllm.distributed.ec_transfer`): optimized for encoder embeddings.
- Device Communicators (`vllm.distributed.device_communicators`): low-level primitives (NCCL, SHM).

vllm-omni complements this with a generalized connector abstraction:

1. Unifies transport via a single `put`/`get` API for any stage artifact.
2. Enables DAG-style pipelines across processes or nodes with per-edge transports.
3. Can wrap vLLM-specific transfers for KV paths while keeping a consistent interface.

## Operational Notes

- Fail-fast config validation: missing expected edges cause startup failures.
- Missing payloads halt stages: verify connector wiring and metadata propagation.

## Future Roadmap: D2D Transport

Current connectors use D2H2D paths. Future versions will introduce direct
device-to-device connectors (NCCL, UCX, IPC) to reduce latency for large
tensor payloads.

## 2. Execution Flow (Arrow Steps, one generate request)

```text
[1] App
    -> AsyncOmni.generate(prompt, request_id)

[2] AsyncOmni
    -> _final_output_handler()   (started on first request)
    -> AsyncOmniEngine.add_request(stage_id=0, ...)

[3] AsyncOmniEngine.add_request
    -> (if stage-0 is llm and input is not EngineCoreRequest)
       InputProcessor.process_inputs()
       OutputProcessor[0].add_request()
    -> request_queue.put(add_request_msg)

[4] Orchestrator._request_handler
    -> _handle_add_request(msg)
    -> stage_clients[0].add_request_async(...)

[5] Orchestrator._orchestration_loop (loop)
    -> poll stage output
       - llm stage: await get_output_async()
       - diffusion stage: get_diffusion_output_nowait()
    -> (llm stage) output_processors[i].process_outputs(...)
    -> _route_output(...)
    -> if finished and not final_stage and non-async-chunk:
         _forward_to_next_stage(...)
         -> next_stage.add_request_async(...)
    -> output_queue.put(output)

[6] AsyncOmni._final_output_loop (background coroutine)
    -> AsyncOmniEngine.try_get_output_async()
    -> route by request_id to ClientRequestState.queue

[7] AsyncOmni._process_orchestrator_results
    -> read from ClientRequestState.queue
    -> _process_single_result(...)
    -> yield OmniRequestOutput

[8] Exit condition
    -> receive result["finished"] == True
    -> generate() ends
```

## 3. Runtime Sequence (one generate request)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant APP as App
    participant AO as AsyncOmni
    participant ENG as AsyncOmniEngine
    participant ORCH as Orchestrator
    participant S0 as Stage-0 Client
    participant SN as Next Stage Client

    APP->>AO: generate
    AO->>AO: start output_handler once
    AO->>ENG: add_request(stage_id=0, ...)
    ENG->>ENG: input_processor.process_inputs()
    ENG->>ORCH: request_queue.put(add_request)

    ORCH->>ORCH: _handle_add_request
    ORCH->>S0: add_request_async

    loop poll route forward
        ORCH->>S0: get_output_async / get_diffusion_output_nowait
        ORCH->>ORCH: _route_output
        alt need forward to next stage
            ORCH->>SN: add_request_async
        end
        ORCH-->>ENG: output_queue.put
    end

    AO->>ENG: try_get_output_async
    ENG-->>AO: message
    AO-->>APP: yield OmniRequestOutput
```

input.rationale: vLLM-Omni 是在 vLLM 基础上扩展的「全模态（omni-modality）推理与服务框架」，其核心特色是 AR+DiT 多阶段、全解耦（OmniConnector + Orchestrator）的运行时。学习路线遵循「先会用 → 再懂机制 → 后能扩展」的递进。入门层 U1 从项目定位、安装、源码地图到离线/在线快速上手，让读者先跑通第一个模型；U2 讲清 vLLM-Omni 如何通过 patch.py、配置体系、输入输出数据结构扩展 vLLM，这是理解整个项目的地基。进阶层用三个单元分别拆解三大核心子系统：U3 多阶段运行时与编排（AsyncOmniEngine/Orchestrator/Stage 进程/OmniConnector/OmniCoordinator），U4 AR 模块（scheduler/worker/model runner/多模态输出），U5 Diffusion 模块（engine/sched/executor/worker/pipeline），对应架构图中的 Entrypoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector；U6 讲在线服务 API。专家层 U7 集中讲 Diffusion 加速（注意力后端/并行注意力/缓存/并行策略/请求级与连续批处理），U8 讲量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析，U9 讲三类模型（Diffusion / Omni 多阶段 / TTS）的扩展开发与实验特性，U10 讲 L1–L5 测试体系与 CI 工程实践。讲义间依赖按「入门→机制→子系统→加速→扩展→工程」串成线性主干，每个加速/扩展主题都依赖其对应的子系统讲义，确保读者始终结合真实源码循序渐进。

data.head: 900a7f0813d0482811b0e4dfd3cf7deabbe2429f
data.rationale: vLLM-Omni 是在 vLLM 基础上扩展的「全模态（omni-modality）推理与服务框架」，其核心特色是 AR+DiT 多阶段、全解耦（OmniConnector + Orchestrator）的运行时。学习路线遵循「先会用 → 再懂机制 → 后能扩展」的递进。入门层 U1 从项目定位、安装、源码地图到离线/在线快速上手，让读者先跑通第一个模型；U2 讲清 vLLM-Omni 如何通过 patch.py、配置体系、输入输出数据结构扩展 vLLM，这是理解整个项目的地基。进阶层用三个单元分别拆解三大核心子系统：U3 多阶段运行时与编排（AsyncOmniEngine/Orchestrator/Stage 进程/OmniConnector/OmniCoordinator），U4 AR 模块（scheduler/worker/model runner/多模态输出），U5 Diffusion 模块（engine/sched/executor/worker/pipeline），对应架构图中的 Entrypoints、AR、Diffusion、OmniConnector；U6 讲在线服务 API。专家层 U7 集中讲 Diffusion 加速（注意力后端/并行注意力/缓存/并行策略/请求级与连续批处理），U8 讲量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析，U9 讲三类模型（Diffusion / Omni 多阶段 / TTS）的扩展开发与实验特性，U10 讲 L1–L5 测试体系与 CI 工程实践。讲义间依赖按「入门→机制→子系统→加速→扩展→工程」串成线性主干，每个加速/扩展主题都依赖其对应的子系统讲义，确保读者始终结合真实源码循序渐进。

理解 worker busy_loop 的消息路由（generation/RPC/shutdown）
了解 DiffusionModelRunner 如何加载 pipeline、刷新 cache backend 并在 set_forward_context 中执行 forward
minimal_modules: DiffusionModelRunner 的 execute_model 与 cache 刷新
lectures.practice_task: 梳理 worker 进程从 ZMQ 收到 generation 消息到调用 pipeline.forward 的调用链，标注 cache_backend.refresh 与 set_forward_context 的位置。

lectures.title: Diffusion Pipeline 与去噪数据流
lectures.topic: 讲解 model-specific 的 pipeline 实现（diffuse 循环、CFG、cache_branch），以及从 encode_prompt 到 vae.decode 的完整数据流。
learning_goals: 掌握 pipeline 的 diffuse 多步循环：transformer.forward → scheduler.step
理解 CFG 的正负 prompt 双前向与 cache_branch 缓存分支
跟踪完整数据流：prepare_latents → diffuse → vae.decode → post_process
minimal_modules: dit_module.md 的 Diffusion Pipeline 与 Data Flow 段
lectures.practice_task: 选择 diffusion/models 下任一 pipeline 实现，阅读其 diffuse 函数，画出「单步去噪」内部的张量流（含 CFG 双前向），并标注 scheduler.step 的输入输出。

lectures.title: Diffusion 模型库与 diffusers 适配器
lectures.topic: 概览 diffusion/models 下覆盖的 46+ 模型实现，并讲解 diffusers_adapter 如何把 diffusers pipeline 通用适配进 vLLM-Omni。
learning_goals: 了解 diffusion/models 目录覆盖的图像/视频/音频模型分类（qwen_image/wan2_2/flux/audiox/cosyvoice3 等）
理解 diffusers_adapter 作为通用 pipeline 适配器的作用与适用场景
了解自定义 pipeline 接入的入口与 examples/diffusers_pipeline_adapter 用法
minimal_modules: diffusion/models 顶层模型目录列表
lectures.practice_task: 在 diffusion/models 中挑选一个图像模型和一个音频模型，比较两者 pipeline 的「输入 prompt 类型」与「输出 modality」，写一份对比说明。

units.title: 在线服务与 OpenAI 兼容 API

lectures.title: API Server：FastAPI 应用构建
lectures.topic: 讲解 api_server.py 如何构建 FastAPI 应用、挂载多模态路由与 WebSocket，并把请求接入 AsyncOmni。
learning_goals: 掌握 build_app / setup_server 的应用构建流程
理解各 OpenAI 兼容端点的挂载方式（chat/images/videos/speech/audio）
了解 API 层如何与 AsyncOmni 引擎对接
minimal_modules: api_server 的 build_app 与路由注册
AsyncOmni 与 serving 模块的绑定
lectures.practice_task: 启动一个 --omni 服务后，用 `curl /v1/models` 与 `/v1/chat/completions` 探测可用路由，列出 api_server.py 中对应每个路由的处理函数。

lectures.title: 多模态端点：Chat / 图像 / 视频 / 语音
lectures.topic: 讲解 serving_chat / serving_video / serving_speech / serving_audio_generate 各端点如何把 OpenAI 请求转成多阶段生成请求。
learning_goals: 掌握 OmniOpenAIServingChat 如何处理多模态 chat（text/audio/image/video content）
理解 serving_video 的 text/image/speech-to-video 与 ReferenceVideo/ReferenceAudio
了解 TTS 端点（serving_speech）与 diffusion 音频端点（serving_audio_generate）的区别及 tts_adapters 作用
minimal_modules: serving_chat 的多模态 content 解析
serving_video 的参考音视频处理
TTS adapter 的请求/参数归一化
lectures.practice_task: 用 chat_completions_api 文档中的请求格式，分别构造一次「文生图」「文生视频」「文生语音」请求，对照源码说明每个请求落到哪个 serving 模块与哪个 stage。

lectures.title: 流式输出与实时/全双工
lectures.topic: 讲解视频流式理解（serving_video_stream）、实时 WebSocket（realtime_connection）与全双工检测（duplex_capability）等流式能力。
learning_goals: 掌握 serving_video_stream 的 Qwen-Omni 实时视频理解 WebSocket 处理
理解 realtime_connection 的双工音频/文本流与张量-numpy 转换
了解 duplex_capability 如何决定是否启用全双工端点
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 realtime_connection.py，画出一个全双工音频会话中「客户端音频帧 → 模型 → 服务端音频帧」的双向数据流，标注张量与 numpy 的转换点。

units.title: Diffusion 加速：注意力、并行、缓存与批处理

lectures.title: 注意力后端：role 感知选择
lectures.topic: 讲解 diffusion attention 的 role 感知后端选择机制（per_role → category → default → platform）、AttentionSpec 与各类后端。
learning_goals: 掌握 Attention 层按 role（self/cross/自定义）声明并由 selector 解析后端的流程
理解 AttentionSpec 的解析优先级与 backend_kwargs 序列化
了解 FLASH_ATTN / TORCH_SDPA / SAGE_ATTN / TRTLLM 等后端的可用性与平台映射
minimal_modules: Attention 层的 role 声明与后端解析
lectures.practice_task: 为一个含 self-attention 与 cross-attention 的 transformer，设计一份 diffusion_attention_config，让 self 用 FLASH_ATTN、cross 用 TORCH_SDPA，并解释解析顺序如何命中。

lectures.title: 并行注意力：Ring 与 Ulysses 序列并行
lectures.topic: 讲解在 attention 层实现的序列并行（Ulysses all-to-all、Ring P2P），它们如何叠加在 AttentionBackend 之上并贡献 sequence_parallel_size。
learning_goals: 掌握 Ulysses 在序列维与头维拆分并用 all-to-all 重分布的机制
理解 Ring Attention 的环形 P2P KV 通信与对底层 kernel 的复用
了解 ring_degree × ulysses_degree = sequence_parallel_size 的关系
minimal_modules: Ulysses 的 all-to-all 重分布
Ring 的 P2P 环形通信
lectures.practice_task: 比较 Ulysses 与 Ring 两种 SP 策略的「通信原语」与「拆分维度」，写出一张对照表，并说明它们如何与 AttentionBackend 组合。

lectures.title: 缓存加速：TeaCache / Cache-DiT / MagCache
lectures.topic: 讲解 cache backend 统一接口与 TeaCache、Cache-DiT（DBCache/SCM/TaylorSeer）、MagCache 等实现，以及 selector 如何按名称选择。
learning_goals: 掌握 CacheBackend 的 enable/refresh/is_enabled 契约
理解 TeaCache 的时间步感知缓存与 HookRegistry 透明注入
了解 Cache-DiT 的 DBCache/SCM/TaylorSeer 与双 transformer 支持，以及 MagCache 的幅度自适应缓存
minimal_modules: CacheBackend 抽象与 get_cache_backend 选择器
Cache-DiT 与 MagCache 的能力差异
lectures.practice_task: 为一个 diffusion 模型分别启用 tea_cache 与 cache_dit，记录推理步数与时间变化，并用 selector.py 解释两种后端是如何被选中的。

lectures.title: 并行策略：TP/SP/DP/CFG/PP/HSDP/VAE
lectures.topic: 讲解 initialize_model_parallel 如何用 RankGenerator 生成正交并行组，以及各类并行（TP/SP/PP/CFG/DP/HSDP/VAE）的 rank 顺序与用途。
learning_goals: 掌握 rank 顺序 tp-sp-pp-cfg-dp 与各并行组的生成
理解 SP/DP/TP/CFG/PP 的用途与适用场景
了解 HSDP 与 VAE 并行在 diffusion 中的作用
lectures.practice_task: 给定总 GPU 数 8、配置 tp=2/sp=2/cfg=2，推算每个 rank 属于哪个并行组，并画出 rank 到 (tp,sp,cfg) 的映射表。

lectures.title: Diffusion 批处理：请求级与连续批处理
lectures.topic: 讲解 request-level batching（max_num_seqs、request_batch_max_wait_ms）与 step-wise continuous batching 两种扩散批处理模式的设计与取舍。
learning_goals: 掌握 request-level batching 如何把兼容请求融合进一次 pipeline.forward(batch)
理解 step-wise continuous batching 如何在去噪步之间加入/移除兼容请求
了解 max_num_seqs=1 串行路径与 >1 批处理路径的区别
minimal_modules: request-level batching 的兼容性键与等待策略
continuous batching 的步间准入/移除
两种模式对 executor 路径的选择
lectures.practice_task: 设计一个实验：用相同 4 条 prompt 分别在 max_num_seqs=1 与 max_num_seqs=4 下测量吞吐，解释批处理带来的吞吐变化与兼容性约束。

units.title: 量化、多硬件平台与性能剖析

lectures.title: 量化体系：统一框架与各方法
lectures.topic: 讲解 quantization 统一框架如何委托 vLLM 注册表并扩展 omni 专属方法（mxfp8/mxfp4/int8/fp8/bnb/inc/quack），以及多阶段模型的 per-component 量化。
learning_goals: 掌握 build_quant_config / SUPPORTED_QUANTIZATION_METHODS 与 factory 的委托机制
理解 mxfp8/mxfp4/int8 等方法在 diffusion transformer 上的在线/离线区别
了解 ComponentQuantizationConfig 如何为多阶段模型做 per-component 量化
minimal_modules: 量化统一框架入口与工厂
各方法 config 的平台适用性
lectures.practice_task: 参考 examples/quantization/quantize_wan2_2_modelopt_fp8.py，说明一次 fp8 量化导出的输入输出，并指出该方法在 factory 中如何被注册。

lectures.title: 平台抽象：CUDA/ROCm/NPU/XPU/MUSA
lectures.topic: 讲解 OmniPlatform 抽象、current_omni_platform 单例与各硬件平台类如何提供 worker 类、注意力后端与默认 stage 配置。
learning_goals: 掌握 OmniPlatform 抽象与 OmniPlatformEnum，以及 current_omni_platform 的惰性单例
理解各平台类（CudaOmniPlatform/NPUOmniPlatform 等）提供的 get_omni_ar_worker_cls / get_diffusion_attn_backend_cls
了解平台如何决定默认注意力后端与默认 stage 配置路径
minimal_modules: 各平台 worker/注意力后端映射
lectures.practice_task: 在两个不同硬件假设（CUDA 与 NPU）下，比较 current_omni_platform 返回的差异（默认注意力后端、worker 类），写一份平台行为对照表。

lectures.title: 基准测试与性能剖析
lectures.topic: 讲解 vllm_omni/benchmarks 与顶层 benchmarks 的用途：diffusion 在线服务压测、注意力后端对比、量化质量评估与 TTS 连续性指标。
learning_goals: 掌握 diffusion_benchmark_serving 的在线压测入口与端点
理解 bench_attention_backends / quantization_quality 的对比评测用途
了解 vllm_omni/benchmarks/serve.py 如何 patch vLLM 的 serve 基准
minimal_modules: diffusion 在线服务压测脚本
注意力后端与量化质量评测
TTS 连续性指标与 profiling 指南
